summary: The source contract permits at most 100 stack-method calls, so no legal command family can provide an honest unbounded scaling verdict for the per-operation design bound.

workload_bound.unit: push, pop, top, and empty calls
workload_bound.source_constraint: The source-fidelity-verified constraint permits at most 100 calls across all four stack methods.

replacement_checks.evidence: With n older values, push performs one enqueue and exactly n front-to-back rotations, proving O(n) time. Pop, top, and empty are O(1); storage is O(n). Across q <= 100 calls, at most q pushes can produce O(q^2) total rotation work, which is contract-bounded and matches the documented aggregate qualification.
Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary command stream without inspecting its definition, including LIFO observations and legal reuse of the structure.
